verification.method: Coarse year probes followed by boundary narrowing; confirmed no rows for the entire queried range from 1900-01-01 through the day before each boundary and one valid OHLC row for each boundary date. Only output2 candles were counted; output1 is a current quote even in historical queries.
verification.limitations: This establishes the current API and credential observed boundary for the tested symbols, not an index inception date, a guaranteed contractual retention period, or continuous completeness of every date. The .IXIC and .SPX probes returned no rows even for current dates and were not treated as supported aliases. Some broad requests returned 100 rows; older data requires shifting the end date.
